# lsm-kv-engine

> Pure Go embedded log-structured merge-tree key-value engine with write-ahead log, memtable, SSTables, Bloom filters, and crash recovery. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u401-lsm-kv-engine`, package `lsmkvengine`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
